findings.title: #1136 AC2 is not delivered and the ticket cannot be closed by this lane: the three chat tools are a successor contract, not a cut
findings.spec_line: "- [ ] The three tools cut into the next `chatTurn` version with their walks." (Agent Brief, acceptance criteria), against the Summary's own purpose: "so the chat lane can carry the #946, #947 and #948 tools".
findings.evidence: Measured: `git diff 061a6992b...HEAD --name-only -- packages/runtime` is EMPTY and FREEZE_BASE_REF=061a6992b check-frozen-workflows is OK 347/60/3, so nothing was cut. This is correct lane behaviour - the lane's ruled scope is 'the DATABASE HALF ONLY ... write each tool as a successor contract' - and the report delivers all three contracts (name, zod input, door call with argument order, refusal mapping, part kind, prompt stanza) in reports/waveS-lane08-ticket1136.md. The contracts are internally sound: clara.get_document_extract(p_document,p_client,p_max_chars) and clara.get_document_state(p_document,p_client) are both already granted to clara_agent_ro (measured), so the non-blocked branches of read_agreement_terms and read_payroll_posting_state are reachable without a new grant.
findings.required_fix: Do NOT close #1136 when this lane merges. The orchestrator re-parents the three contracts to the mainline's next chatTurn cut and carries AC2 there; the capability the ticket exists for does not exist until then.

findings.title: #1137 builds SIX agent read twins and a ninth split of a non-tenancy door, where the plan of record scoped the lane to TWO reads
findings.spec_line: SWEEP-PLAN.md lines 217-219: "The ten tenancy doors of 0300 are all `clara_authenticated` only. #1137 needs twins for two reads, `get_contract_terms` (0300:600) and `get_rent_settlement_candidates` (0300:1974)." and line 104: "two reads for #1137, plus two more only if the owner rules OBO twins".
findings.evidence: 0353 mints wake twins for SIX reads (get_contract_terms, get_tenancy_rent_plan_draft, propose_contract_terms, get_tenancy_escalation_revision, get_rent_settlement_candidates, get_tenancy_deposit_coding) and additionally SPLITS clara.revise_accounting_plan (0193, plan family - not one of the ten 0300 doors #1137 names as key interfaces). The widening is grounded in the ticket's other key interface, #949's successor contract, whose two read TOOLS call three and two doors, and whose revision confirmation ends in clara.revise_accounting_plan (0300:2499, measured) - so the two tools genuinely cannot work on two doors. It is still four more agent-reachable doors and one more recut body than the plan budgeted. Measured harmlessness: all six cores contain zero write statements, the six wake doors are clara_agent_ro only, and the allowlist gains exactly six `interactive` rows with nothing for an act.
findings.required_fix: The orchestrator ratifies the widening explicitly (a line on #1137 or in SWEEP-PLAN), so the model lane's reach into the tenancy family is a recorded decision rather than a lane's own reading.

findings.title: The (T.4) row-lock probe was narrowed in the same commit that needs it - and the lane's justification checks out
findings.spec_line: The report's claim: "Measured on the live catalog: of the roster's bodies only the revision core carries `for update` at all, so no body that was checked before is skipped now."
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED by re-measurement. The probe moved from `src.indexOf("from clara.accounting_plans where id")` to `src.search(/from clara.accounting_plans where id [^;]*for update/)`. clara._revise_accounting_plan_core has a plain firm-walled re-resolution read at offset 1100 (which would have failed the old probe, the rung being at 4210) and its `for update` at 4498, so the rung-above-LOCK claim still holds. create_accounting_plan, _accrual_plan_core and _tenancy_plan_core contain the old substring ZERO times, so the old probe was already inert for them. No coverage was lost, and the new (T.5) pin on the thin delegate is additive.
findings.required_fix: None. Recorded because a guard relaxed in the commit that needs it is the shape a reviewer must not wave through.

findings.title: read_agreement_terms gained a client_id input that #948's contract did not have
